sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report pertains to customer C02923 and debit/credit card C02923-K1. Graph analytics identified a shared hardware syndicate linking this account to multiple other customer profiles including C03278, C09872, C02716. Between 2016-12-07 and 2016-12-07, transaction activity totaling $100.07 USD was flagged for anomalous risk indicators, initiated via the online channel under merchant product category R. The primary flagged transaction 3523199 occurred on 2016-12-07 21:38:37 for an amount of $100.07. Online authentication originated from digital hardware profile 'iOS Device | iOS 9.3.5 | mobile safari 9.0 | 1024x768' with proxy routing classified as 'Direct/None'. The modus operandi involved credential capture and card-not-present exploitation originating from an unrecognized new device profile without prior account history. Upon formal bank outreach, the cardholder explicitly denied initiating or authorizing the transactions and confirmed physical possession of the original card. The financial institution has permanently blocked card C02923-K1 to prevent further financial exposure, staged appropriate fraud chargebacks, and placed all connected cards under heightened surveillance.
